slices: The Field Collector private collection-detail route now publishes a strict response envelope, binds collection and location to the request, permits flexible JSON form fields only within the 512 KiB payload bound, and rejects malformed review events/evidence with sanitized no-store responses.
The scheduler job-plan CLI now accepts and forwards a registered driver instance for sensor plans; missing inputs fail before any database access and generated plans remain disabled.
Resource-efficiency analytics now aggregates harvest and labor independently per cycle, joins crops through crop_cycle.crop_id, and includes only events whose location matches their target cycle.

assertions: Two harvest and two labor rows for one cycle aggregate to 150 kg and 5 hours without join multiplication.
